shorts.hook: Orcas hunt great white sharks for one organ.
shorts.title: Orcas Hunt Great White Sharks for Just One Organ
shorts.outro: Then Doug dressed as a great white. Full video below.
shorts.description: Orcas left five great whites on South African beaches with their livers torn out, and the rest fled within hours; the full episode is linked below.

shorts.title: One Orca Visit Kept Great Whites Away Up to a Year
shorts.outro: Doug kept their spot warm for a whole year. Full video below.
shorts.description: After one short orca visit, Farallon great whites gave up their whole hunting season and moved down the coast; watch the full episode linked below.

shorts.title: 300 Great White Sightings in 2011, Zero in 2019
shorts.outro: Doug became the last great white in False Bay. Full video below.
shorts.description: Cape Town's shark spotters went from over 300 great white sightings a year to none as orcas moved into False Bay; the full story is in the episode linked below.
